title: Polynomials with restricted support and maximal zeros on a finite Cartesian set
summary: Given a finite Cartesian set $S=X \times Y$ and a decreasing set of monomials $\mathcal M$, we call extremal polynomials for $\mathcal M$ over $S$ those that have the maximum number of zeros in $S$ and whose support belongs to $\mathcal M$. Coordinate factorizations give a family of extremal polynomials; we call them canonical. If $\max(\mathcal M)$, taken with respect to divisibility, is a single monomial, all extremal polynomials are canonical.
